win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 8 or more symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 One would think the worst thing to come out of Hell was the Devil himself. But it looks like someone left Hell’s nursery gates open…

 Meet the Devil’s Spawn and his Pyropup, two hellraisers who leave a trail of tears behind them as they run wild across the infernal realm. Together, they tumble through the Devil’s playground, setting souls ablaze and tormenting the tormented.

 Pray for Six is a 6-reel, 5-row cascading game with All-Scatter wins and a max win of 20 000 times your bet, achievable in all game modes.

 Looks like it’s playtime in Purgatory — and Balthazar and Bee
